hero.title: Forever Star India National Pageant 2026
hero.text: Grassroots auditions across 4,000+ Indian cities for Miss, Mrs & Teen India titles. One crowned city winner from every represented city, with a live televised coronation at Zee Studio Jaipur.

stats.label: Dreamers who chose FSIA as their stage

jury.name: Arbaaz Khan
jury.text: Bollywood actor, director and producer gracing the grand stage at Zee Studio Jaipur, felicitating national winners and applauding grassroots talent from across 4,000+ cities.

jury.name: Malaika Arora
jury.role: Celebrity Guest of Honour & Style Icon
jury.text: Indian style icon and celebrated Bollywood personality presenting honours to visionary women, entrepreneurs and crowned titleholders at the Forever Star India coronation.

jury.name: VIP Guests & National Jury
jury.text: Eminent public figures, veterans and industry stalwarts gracing the stage to crown achievers and support humanitarian initiatives.

winners.name: Tanvi Yatin Khairnar
winners.title: Miss Teen India 2025
winners.quote: As a teenager, having access to national media coaching and runway mentors gave me the courage to advocate for education and youth empowerment.

winners.name: Neeharika Bethanapalli
winners.title: Miss India 2025
winners.quote: Standing on the Zee Studio grand stage with the national sash was surreal. FSIA recognized my authentic voice and gave me a platform with nationwide credibility.

winners.name: Anjali Sinha
winners.title: Mrs India 2025 (G-1)
winners.quote: FSIA proved that marriage and motherhood are not pauses, but powerful accelerators of our strength, poise, and societal leadership.

winners.name: Bhumika Songara
winners.title: Mrs India 2025 (G-2)
winners.quote: At 40+, FSIA gave me the grandest runway in India. True beauty is forged in life experience, confidence, and resilience.

winners.name: Dr Srujana Devi
winners.title: Miss Forever Universe India 2025
winners.quote: As a medical professional, FSIA provided the bridge between science and advocacy, demonstrating that intelligence and elegance walk hand in hand.

winners.name: Saartha Sameer Gore
winners.title: Miss Forever Universe 2025
winners.quote: From Goa’s coastal auditions to the national spotlight, FSIA transformed my self-belief into an unstoppable force on the runway.

events.title: Forever Miss Teen India 2026 – Poise & Runway Masterclass
events.text: Digital and hybrid ramp-walk masterclass by national choreographers and former titleholders for registered teen contestants.

events.title: Grand Finale & Award Ceremony
events.text: Grand Finale and Award Ceremony at The Fern Nest by Marriott, Jaipur.
